create_gaussian_process_classifier: create a GaussianProcessClassifier with an RBF kernel and fixed hyperparameters for classification
run_gpc_fit_optimize: run GaussianProcessClassifier.fit on training data with automatic hyperparameter optimization
test_gpc_predict_proba: test GaussianProcessClassifier.predict_proba to get predicted class probabilities
test_gpc_accuracy_log_loss: test GaussianProcessClassifier with accuracy_score and log_loss metrics on predictions
run_gpc_log_marginal_likelihood: run GaussianProcessClassifier.log_marginal_likelihood to evaluate kernel hyperparameter quality
